author: cairn
blurb: Current weather and forecasts by latitude/longitude. No API key needed.

definition.name: Open-Meteo Weather
definition.description: Free weather forecast API — no key required.
definition.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_weather","description":"Get current weather for a location by coordinates.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"latitude":{"type":"number","description":"Latitude, e.g. 52.52"},"longitude":{"type":"number","description":"Longitude, e.g. 13.41"},"current":{"type":"string","description":"Comma-separated fields, e.g. 'temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m'","default":"temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m"}},"required":["latitude","longitude"]}}
